boards.title: Top 10 by tournaments won
boards.tieRule: Every tournament on record, from a Global Championship to a $50 cup - first place only. Level counts are split by career earnings, so of two players on the same number the bigger earner ranks higher.

boards.title: Top 10 by LAN wins
boards.tieRule: Offline main events in the top two tiers, so the Globals and the World Cup but also DreamHack, Gamers8 and the Esports World Cup. Level counts are split by career earnings, so of two players on the same number the bigger earner ranks higher.

boards.title: Top 10 by top-5 finishes at FNCS finals
boards.tieRule: Fifth or better at an FNCS grand final, counting every season and region. Level counts are split by career earnings, so of two players on the same number the bigger earner ranks higher.

boards.title: Top 10 by FNCS grand finals without ever winning one
boards.tieRule: Grand finals reached by players whose FNCS title count is still zero. One win and you leave this board for good. Level counts are split by career earnings, so of two players on the same number the bigger earner ranks higher.

boards.title: Top 10 earners who have never won an FNCS
boards.tieRule: Career prize money, among players with no FNCS title. Straight prize-money order.

boards.title: Top 10 by consecutive FNCS grand finals qualified for
boards.tieRule: The longest run of FNCS grand finals in a row, counting every region's own final as one round. Miss a round and the run starts again. Level counts are split by career earnings, so of two players on the same number the bigger earner ranks higher.

boards.title: Top 10 by consecutive FNCS titles
boards.tieRule: Winning your region's grand final in consecutive rounds of the FNCS. Level counts are split by career earnings, so of two players on the same number the bigger earner ranks higher.

boards.title: Top 10 by FNCS titles across different chapters
boards.tieRule: How many different chapters of Fortnite a player has won an FNCS in - three titles in one chapter counts once. Level counts are split by career earnings, so of two players on the same number the bigger earner ranks higher.

boards.title: Top 10 youngest ever to win a major
boards.tieRule: Age on the first day of the event, for every Epic-run tier-1 final since the World Cup. Players with no published birthday cannot be ranked.

boards.title: Top 10 oldest ever to win a major
boards.tieRule: The same list read from the other end: the oldest anyone has been on the day they won an Epic-run tier-1 final.

boards.title: Top 10 oldest to win a first major
boards.tieRule: Age at a maiden title rather than at any title, so a long wait counts and a long career does not.
